instructions.content: Melt 1 tablespoon of the butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the bell peppers and onions and saute until softened. Add the ham, scallion, and black pepper. Cook for 1-2 minutes and transfer the mixture. Clean the skillet.
Whisk together the eggs and salt while the skillet reheats.

Coat the skillet with the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter. Pour in the egg, and use a rubber spatula to gently tuck the edges of the egg inward. When the egg is half cooked, add the filling and cheese to half of the egg, and fold the empty half of the egg over the filling. Remove from heat and rest for 1 minute.

notes: The omelet might cook better if covered with a lid before removing it from the heat.
If making several omelets before serving, transfer them to a baking pan instead of allowing each omelet to rest for a minute, and store them in a warm oven.
